# LiftOffr

> LiftOffr is a Bitcoin cycle indicator framework, Discord community, and 6-module course teaching data-driven crypto investing. Backtested track record: $50/week DCA + cycle signals turned into $1.88M since 2017.

LiftOffr is for crypto investors who want to time cycle exits using on-chain data instead of emotion. The product tracks 8 cycle indicators (CBBI, MVRV, Pi Cycle Top, Puell Multiple, 2-Year MA Multiplier, BTC Rainbow Chart, Fear & Greed Index, Google Trends) and synthesizes them into a single plain-English daily brief delivered to a private Discord at 8am MT.

Founded by Torin Christianson (4M+ content views across Instagram, YouTube, TikTok). No subscriptions. Offers: My Bear Market Buy Plan ($29 one-time — Torin's exact tier-by-tier accumulation plan with timestamped receipts, at /plan), The Cycle System ($197 one-time — the full indicator course + exit ladder, lifetime updates), and The Cycle Playbook ($497 — a private 1:1 session, 4 spots/month). The scoreboard layer (live Score, daily brief, Sunday Score email, open Discord) is free at /free.

## Indicator guides
- [CBBI Explained](https://liftoffr.com/blog/cbbi-bitcoin-indicator): Composite 0–100 cycle score from 9 on-chain signals
- [MVRV Ratio](https://liftoffr.com/blog/mvrv-ratio-bitcoin-indicator): Market Value vs Realized Value
- [Pi Cycle Top](https://liftoffr.com/blog/pi-cycle-top-bitcoin-indicator): 111-day vs 350-day×2 MA cross
- [Puell Multiple](https://liftoffr.com/blog/puell-multiple-bitcoin-indicator): Miner revenue cycle signal
- [Rainbow Chart](https://liftoffr.com/blog/bitcoin-rainbow-chart-indicator): Logarithmic price color bands
- [2-Year MA Multiplier](https://liftoffr.com/blog/bitcoin-2-year-ma-multiplier): Long-term mean reversion
- [Fear & Greed Index](https://liftoffr.com/blog/crypto-fear-greed-index-bitcoin): Sentiment-based cycle signal
- [Google Trends Bitcoin](https://liftoffr.com/blog/google-trends-bitcoin-indicator): Retail search interest
- [How to Identify a Bitcoin Cycle Top](https://liftoffr.com/blog/how-to-identify-bitcoin-cycle-top): The 8-indicator confluence framework

## Public APIs
- [/api/subscribe](https://liftoffr.com/api/subscribe): POST — adds email to LiftOffr free list and immediately sends the welcome email (Cycle Top Checklist PDF + current LiftOffr Score)
- [/api/cycle-score](https://liftoffr.com/api/cycle-score): GET — returns the live LiftOffr Score (0-100 composite of the 8 BTC cycle indicators), zone, trend, and component readings
